meta.title: Offering more than the requested quantity is refused

words.preconditions: A fresh published RFQ event where the invited QA vendor has submitted a bid; bidding still open.
steps: The invited QA vendor sends the bid call, exactly as the matching library case writes it.
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with “Quantity cannot be greater than the mentioned quantity.”, and never with a server error.

plan.title: Offering more than the requested quantity is refused

expected.message: Quantity cannot be greater than the mentioned quantity.
